name: Highlight Sweep
description: A two-line headline blurs in, then an accent marker sweeps behind the key phrase and the text inverts exactly where the marker has passed.
move: A two-line headline blurs in, then an accent marker sweeps behind the key phrase and the text inverts exactly where the marker has passed.
how: The marked phrase holds a bar (scaleX from the left) and a dark copy of the text clipped with clip-path inset to the same box; one progress value drives both through a timeline onUpdate, so they never drift. Sweep 0.75s with cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1). On exit the bar retracts from the left edge.
adapt: Wrap the emphasised phrase in the .mark structure (bar, base, over with identical text). Placeholder copy is generic; replace it with the product's words. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: All motion is inline in index.html. GSAP pages: register the CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot element and rebuild the same timeline; the split helper is inline and dependency-free.
caveats: Original implementation of the After Effects "Marker highlight with track matte" idea; no AE preset files, expressions or numbers are copied and fidelity to a specific AE render is not claimed.
Starts and ends on an empty stage so it loops cleanly; trim the exit when the next shot cuts in.
